_EVENT_NAME = re.compile(r"^on[a-z]+$")


def _is_event_attr(name):
    """True for real HTML event handler attributes (onclick, onerror, ...).

    Framework attributes such as ``on-tap``/``on:click``/``on_x`` are inert in
    a browser and are therefore kept.
    """
    return bool(_EVENT_NAME.match(name))
